Sample.evidence_source: Sixty elderly people at risk of suicide were interviewed

Country.evidence_source: The 13 Brazilian municipalities in which the study was conducted have suicide rates among elderly people of over 10/100,000.

Population.evidence_source: Sixty elderly people at risk of suicide were interviewed, after selection with the help of health professionals involved with caring for these elderly individuals in hospitals, Psychosocial Care Centers, Integral Care Centers for the Elderly, Family Health Strategy Centers, Long-Term Institutions (ILPI) and Health Surveillance Centers.

Type.evidence_source: The main qualitative tool used in collecting the data was a format to guide the in-depth interviews, together with an identification form3 .

Area.evidence_source: This field information was first analysed by the local investigators and then cross-categorized by the two undersigned researchers, by means used in the attempts or expressions of ideation, severity of the events and reasons given by the elderly people: by sex, age, socioeconomic profile, risk factors and protection factors.
